name: Hi I am new here
description: Cute shy cartoon boy, caption 'Hi I am New Here'. Soft first-hello when joining a chat or introducing yourself.
whenToUse: Use when the bot or user is new to a group, saying first hello, 'just joined', 'who is this', or a gentle intro. Good for first DM too if the vibe is shy/polite rather than street. Prefer over greet_all when it is one person introducing, not hailing the whole room.
whenNotToUse: Skip if the chat is already familiar, for arguments, or when a louder Nigerian hail (my_boss, steeze, greet_all) fits better.
